headline: Short-period S slop under cross wind — a nothing day out east.
today: 1.1-1.7ft at 4 seconds from due south with W cross all day. That's weak, gutless windswell and a long drive for nothing. Wait for the weekend.

daysToWatch.note: Swell fills to 2.6ft but S onshore 17mph at dawn and cross-on SW after — junky, not the day.

This is the one. 2-plus feet at a prime SSE angle with N offshore at dawn going light by afternoon. Clean and worth the drive — morning glass, then a mellow midday session. Fish or shortboard if it's got size, log if it goes soft.
